record.question: There is a shortage of wheat in your District where you are the District Magistrate. The Government has ordered that only a maximum amount of 50 kg wheat is to be released for wedding celebrations. A daughter of your close relative is getting married and your requests you to release at least 100 kg wheat, for his daughter's wedding. He expresses annoyance when you tell him about the Government's restrictions on this matter. He feels that since you are the District Magistrate you can release any amount at your will. You do not want to spoil your relationship with him. Under such circumstances, how would you deal with the situation?
options: Release the extra amount of wheat which your relative has requested for.
Refuse your relative the extra amount and strictly follow the rules.
Show your relative the copy of the Government instructions and then persuade him to accept the amount as prescribed.
Advise him to directly apply to the allotting authority and inform him that you do not interfere in this matter.
